description: Project management for the non-project manager

Strimzi cluster operator: run Apache Kafka on Kubernetes from CRDs (Kafka, KafkaNodePool, KafkaTopic, KafkaUser, KafkaConnect, KafkaMirrorMaker2). The CRDs ship with the chart; brokers, controllers, Connect and Kafka Exporter run on the QuenchWorks strimzi-kafka image. Cruise Control is not support…
